<!--
THE FIGURE 5 PRODUCER since 2026-08-27, promoted from figure_5_variant_invtau.Rmd. The tau-axis
version it replaces is archive/figure_5_tau_axis.Rmd; the one change between them is that the
horizontal axis is 1 / tau_9 instead of tau_9. Same four members, same shared y, same colours, same
text sizes, same source data. Everything the archived header settled stays settled: FOUR MEMBERS
(ILSE, INR, R, IR, the factorial of interval averaging against recursion) and ONE SHARED Y (the
vertical distance between members at the same x IS what switching likelihood buys).

WHY THE INVERSE IS NOT JUST A MIRROR. On a log x it is exactly the mirror image and buys nothing by
itself. What it buys is that the axis becomes the DEFLATION FACTOR the reader would apply: if the
recording holds N intervals and the fit believes them independent, the repair is N_eff = N / tau_int,
so 1 / tau_int IS the multiplier, running from 1 (every interval independent) down toward 0.

AND IT LETS THE NULL BE DRAWN. Under the deflation hypothesis the reported information is too large
by exactly tau_int, so the distortion should equal tau_int: the prediction is distortion = 1 / x,
drawn here as the dashed line. A mark ON the line is a member whose error bar the reader could
repair with the number they measured. A mark OFF it is not, and the length of the bar says no
scalar works at all. That is the subsection's claim, in the figure rather than in the prose.

THE FLOOR IS THE ESTIMATOR, NOT THE DATA, AND THE WINDOW IS NINE POSITIVE LAGS. max_lag = 10 at
ops/local/figure_4.macroir:153, but sqr_X (legacy/moment_statistics.h:68) fills offsets
0..max_lag-1 and the Omega loop (line 1727) runs offset = 1 while offset < size, so the sum is
1 + 2*sum_{k=1..9}. The bound is 19, not 21, and the axis cannot go below 1/19 = 0.053. The left
edge of this panel is a property of the window. The manuscript writes the statistic tau_9 for that
reason. Found by an adversarial audit 2026-08-27, which also corrected the max_lag = 200 test
predictions to about 191 / 92 / 33 at Delta_tilde = 0.01 / 0.02 / 0.05.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressMessages({ library(tidyverse) })
```

```{r data}
source("noise_units.R")

SRC <- "../figure_4_source_data"
rd  <- function(f) read.csv(file.path(SRC, f), skip = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

LAB  <- c(nonlinearsqr = "ILSE", macro_INR = "INR", macro_R = "R", macro_IR = "IR")
KEEP <- names(LAB)

pw10 <- function(x) {
  e <- round(log10(x))
  ifelse(abs(e) <= 2, format(x, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), sprintf("10^%d", e))
}

tau <- rd("figure_4_source_data_cell_scalars.csv") %>%
  filter(param == "lag", anchor == "pool", algo == "nonlinearsqr") %>%
  transmute(noise, Num_ch, interval_in_tau, tau_int = v)

spec <- rd("figure_4_source_data_spectrum.csv") %>%
  filter(anchor == "pool", algo %in% KEEP) %>%
  select(algo, param, noise, Num_ch, interval_in_tau, m) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = m)

dat <- spec %>%
  inner_join(tau, by = c("noise", "Num_ch", "interval_in_tau")) %>%
  filter(is.finite(mag), is.finite(aniso), mag > 0, aniso > 0) %>%
  mutate(inv_tau = 1 / tau_int,
         lo = mag / aniso, hi = mag * aniso,
         member = factor(unname(LAB[algo]), levels = unname(LAB)),
         S   = dimensionless_noise(as.numeric(noise)),
         s   = factor(pw10(S), levels = pw10(sort(unique(S)))),
         nch = factor(pw10(Num_ch), levels = pw10(sort(unique(Num_ch)))),
         d   = factor(sprintf("%g", interval_in_tau),
                      levels = sprintf("%g", sort(unique(interval_in_tau)))),
         sweep = interaction(interval_in_tau, Num_ch, drop = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(member, sweep, S)

cat(sprintf("variant: %d marks over %d cells in %d panels; 1/tau_int from %.3f to %.3f\n",
            nrow(dat), n_distinct(dat[c("noise","Num_ch","interval_in_tau")]),
            nlevels(dat$member), min(dat$inv_tau), max(dat$inv_tau)))
```

```{r render, fig.width = 7.0, fig.height = 3.8}
# the deflation null: distortion = tau_int, i.e. y = 1/x on this axis.
null_line <- tibble(inv_tau = 10 ^ seq(log10(0.045), 0, length.out = 200)) %>%
  mutate(mag = 1 / inv_tau)

g <- ggplot(dat, aes(inv_tau, mag, colour = d)) +
  geom_line(data = null_line, aes(inv_tau, mag), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_line(aes(group = sweep), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_point(size = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~ member, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1),
                labels = c("0.05", "0.1", "0.2", "0.5", "1")) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.3, 1, 3, 10, 30, 100),
                labels = c("0.3", "1", "3", "10", "30", "100")) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = expression(widetilde(Delta)), option = "D", end = 0.92) +
  labs(x = expression("effective fraction of independent intervals,  "*1/tau[9]),
       y = "distortion of the reported information\n(point = size, bar = across directions)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.key.height = unit(9, "pt"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(3, "pt"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7))

ggsave("Figure_5.pdf", g, width = 7.0, height = 3.8, device = cairo_pdf)
g
```

```{r how_far_from_the_null}
# The whole point of the axis: how far is each mark from the deflation prediction, and does the
# bar cover it? ratio = measured size / tau_int; covered = the null falls inside [lo, hi].
dat %>%
  mutate(ratio = mag / tau_int,
         covered = tau_int >= lo & tau_int <= hi) %>%
  group_by(member) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            ratio_med = median(ratio), ratio_lo = min(ratio), ratio_hi = max(ratio),
            covered = sum(covered), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print(digits = 3)

cat("\nsame, restricted to the cells where the deflation would be worth doing (tau_int > 2):\n")
dat %>% filter(tau_int > 2) %>%
  mutate(ratio = mag / tau_int, covered = tau_int >= lo & tau_int <= hi) %>%
  group_by(member) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), ratio_med = median(ratio), ratio_lo = min(ratio), ratio_hi = max(ratio),
            covered = sum(covered), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print(digits = 3)

cat("\nand at the white end (1/tau_int > 0.83, i.e. tau_int < 1.20), where the claim is made:\n")
dat %>% filter(inv_tau > 1/1.20) %>%
  group_by(member) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), size_lo = min(mag), size_hi = max(mag),
            shape_lo = min(aniso), shape_hi = max(aniso), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print(digits = 3)
```
